title: Local Text Output
description: A target component that writes data to the file system. It supports
outputting structured or unstructured content to files in a variety
of formats such as JSON, CSV, or plain text. Configurable with output
paths and naming conventions, the component enables flexible persistence
of processed data to networked storage.

local_text_output.exclude.title: Exclude prefix
local_text_output.exclude.description: Which paths to exclude from the output path, if not required put N/A. e.g Users/Downloads/ or N/A
